title: A Reusable Semantic Web Framework for Evidence-Grounded Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments under the EU AI Act

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying AI incident records and legal texts into risk patterns (including bias/discrimination) using keyword matching, an LLM classifier (Claude Sonnet), and a hybrid approach, evaluated against a manually annotated gold standard using Cohen's kappa and percentage agreement.

Analyzing the composition of the curated AI incident corpus (e.g., AIAAIC repository) and evaluating its limitations, noting that it predominantly draws from U.S. and U.K. English-language sources, which introduces geographic bias in the context of EU regulatory assessments.
